properties.name: Chatrium Riverside — 2x 2BR River-View Suites
properties.fits_9: Two 120sqm 2-bedroom suites side by side: king + twins, lounge, kitchenette each; free crib for Aliya. Kids 0-6 stay free.
properties.accessibility: Large elevators, step-free lobby and pool deck, flat riverside promenade. Shuttle boat needs assisted boarding — taxis easier.

properties.name: Somerset Ekamai — 3BR Deluxe + 1BR
properties.fits_9: 3BR Deluxe sleeps 7 (8-seater dining, full kitchen, washer/dryer) + 1BR on the same floor for the third couple. Best self-catering value for 9.
properties.accessibility: Modern tower, elevators, step-free entry; ask for units near the lift core.

properties.name: Chatrium Residence Sathon — 3BR + 2BR
properties.fits_9: Suites with full living/dining + kitchenettes; 3BR + 2BR pairing sleeps all 9 with room to spread. Big lagoon pool for the kids; 10% off direct.
properties.accessibility: Elevator buildings, step-free common areas, wide corridors for the scooter.

properties.name: Anantara Riverside — 2x Family Suites
properties.fits_9: Two river-view Family Suites (kids' entertainment incl. game console) + crib. Huge riverside pool, kids club, lawn — the classic Bangkok family resort.
properties.accessibility: Flat, elevator-served, accessible rooms available; car transfer step-free (river shuttle needs assist).

properties.name: Shangri-La Bangkok — 2x interconnecting pairs
properties.fits_9: Two interconnecting pairs (72sqm each: Deluxe King + Twin) + crib. Kids 6 and under eat buffet free.
properties.accessibility: One of Bangkok's most wheelchair-friendly hotels: ramps, big elevators, accessible rooms, flat riverside gardens; BTS next door has lifts.

properties.name: Mandarin Oriental — interconnecting Deluxe
properties.fits_9: Dedicated family programme, interconnected rooms + 2BR suites, river-wing club access; 2 pairs + crib covers all 9 in full grande-dame luxury.
properties.accessibility: Flat riverfront, valet drop-off, elevators, accessible rooms on request.

properties.name: Natural Villas — Riverside 5BR Pool Villa
properties.fits_9: 5 bedrooms for up to 10 — every couple gets a room; 10x4m pool, full kitchen, BBQ, gym, full-time maid and gardener included. THB 9,999/night listed.
properties.accessibility: Ground-level living + pool terrace; confirm a ground-floor bedroom for Nana (some bedrooms upstairs).

properties.name: 138 Villa Chang Khlan (Night Bazaar)
properties.fits_9: 5 bedrooms, 6 baths, saltwater pool, daily housekeeping. Explicit toddler kit: high chair, kids' dinnerware, baby bathtub. Walk to Night Bazaar.
properties.accessibility: Open-plan ground level — request ground-floor bedroom; upper rooms via stairs.

properties.name: Shangri-La Chiang Mai — 2x connecting pairs
properties.fits_9: Four rooms in two connecting pairs; free kids club (4-12), children's pool with waterslide, largest pool in the city — the easy hotel option.
properties.accessibility: Elevators, step-free lobby/pool, accessible rooms available.

properties.name: Anantara Serviced Suites — 3BR + 2BR
properties.fits_9: 3BR + 2BR suite combo sleeps the whole group with ensuite bedrooms + shared living; riverside Anantara resort facilities across the road.
properties.accessibility: Elevator building, step-free entry; flat riverfront lawn. Confirm scooter charging with concierge.

properties.name: Four Seasons Chiang Mai — Residence Villa
properties.fits_9: Multi-bedroom Residence Villas with private pool among the rice paddies; dedicated Residence Assistant, kids club, family rice-farming experiences. Kids 18 and under free in same room.
properties.accessibility: Hillside estate — buggy service everywhere; request a step-free residence near the main pavilion (some villas have stairs/slopes).

properties.name: 137 Pillars House — 3-suite takeover
properties.fits_9: Three large heritage suites (70-135sqm; William Bain sleeps 4) = 9-10. Intimate colonial-Lanna compound near the Ping River; 25% off 3+ nights direct.
properties.accessibility: Ramps in circulation areas but many stairs — book ground-floor suites and confirm scooter routing first.

activities.name: Grand Palace & Emerald Buddha
activities.ages: All ages; strict dress code; go early
activities.accessibility: Step-free paved main route; FREE loaner wheelchairs at entrance; scooter fine on main paths

activities.name: Wat Pho — Reclining Buddha
activities.ages: All ages; pairs with Grand Palace next door. Under 120cm free
activities.accessibility: Mostly flat with ramps; Buddha hall reachable — shoes off, staff-assisted transfer at hall entrance

activities.name: Chao Phraya Princess dinner cruise
activities.ages: All ages — kid-friendly buffet, 2h loop past lit-up Wat Arun
activities.accessibility: Operator explicitly wheelchair & stroller accessible: ramped piers + boarding assist — the scooter-friendly cruise

activities.name: Mahanakhon SkyWalk (78F glass tray)
activities.ages: Glass tray for Amirah; toddler free; senior discount 60+
activities.accessibility: High-speed lifts, step-free decks; scooter fine

activities.name: SEA LIFE Bangkok Ocean World
activities.ages: Perfect for Naeema + Aliya (ocean tunnel, penguins); under 2 free; fully indoor
activities.accessibility: Full elevator access, smooth floors, published accessibility guide

activities.name: ICONSIAM & Sook Siam indoor floating market
activities.ages: All ages — indoor floating-market food hall; teens get flagship shopping
activities.accessibility: Elevators, wide aisles, step-free river promenade — easiest outing in Bangkok

activities.name: Elephant Nature Park — half-day visit (ethical, no riding)
activities.ages: All ages — observation-based; child 3-11 half price, infant 25%; incl. pickup + vegan buffet
activities.accessibility: The ONLY major sanctuary that officially welcomes wheelchair users — raised walkways + platforms; email ahead for accessible routing

activities.name: Thai Farm Cooking School (organic farm)
activities.ages: Naeema cooks with a parent, Amirah gets her own station; book private for the group of 9
activities.accessibility: Flat farm grounds + open pavilions; confirm scooter loading in the minivan

activities.name: Muay Thai fight night — Thaphae Stadium
activities.ages: Perfect for Amirah + adults; loud and late — Nana and Aliya may skip
activities.accessibility: Ground-floor stadium seating; WhatsApp ahead for an accessible spot

activities.name: Sunday Walking Street night market
activities.ages: All ages — crafts, lanterns, temple-courtyard food courts (Sundays only)
activities.accessibility: Flat pedestrianized 1km — go EARLY (4:30-6pm); after dark too crowded to maneuver

activities.name: Doi Suthep mountain temple
activities.ages: All ages — Amirah climbs the 306-step naga staircase, everyone else rides
activities.accessibility: A funicular bypasses all 306 steps (06:00-18:00) + elevator to the ticket booth — genuinely doable on the scooter

notes: Dec-Feb is Thailand's peak cool season — book villas and Four Seasons 6+ months out. Christmas/NYE weeks carry mandatory gala-dinner supplements at luxury hotels ($100-200/adult). Shangri-La Bangkok is the standout accessible property; Elephant Nature Park is the documented mobility-friendly sanctuary; Doi Suthep's funicular eliminates the 306 steps. Aliya (age 1) is free essentially everywhere; kids under 120cm free at Grand Palace and Wat Pho.
